instruction: My roommate asked me to return something I had ordered for them and venmo them the money for it. Check my messages for details and do as per their instruction.
notes: The roommate is identified via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"), which also yields their email (used as the Venmo receiver) and phone number (used to pull the instructing text message). The message names the product; amazon.show_orders(query=product name) locates the order, amazon.show_order reveals product_id, quantity and item cost, show_return_deliverers supplies a deliverer_id for initiate_return. Goal demands exactly one return (right order/product) and one Venmo transaction to the roommate for the order cost, mirroring the evaluation; gmail/file_system side effects are automatic consequences of initiate_return and are not modeled. Static world facts in :init (who sent which message, what the order contains) represent the environment; knowledge predicates (known-*) track what the agent has discovered.
